articles.summary: Fracture toughness tests are used to determine a material's resistance to crack propagation. Learn more about it here.
articles.title: Fracture Toughness Tests: Definition, Purpose, Standards, Process, and Benefits

articles.summary: An impact test is used to determine a material’s impact strength, or the material’s ability to resist deformation when subjected to a sudden shock or impulse load. Learn more about it here.
articles.title: Impact Test: Definition, Types, Benefits, and Standards

articles.summary: Vapor smoothing PETG refers to the post-processing technique used to improve the surface irregularity of 3D-printed parts made from PETG filament or powder. Learn more about it here.
articles.title: Vapor Smoothing PETG: Definition, Purpose, How It Works, Advantages, and Examples
